Step-by-Step Audio Guided Tour: restaurant tour of La Marée restaurant, Monaco
Tour-Category: restaurant

Stop 1: La Marée

Coordinates: 43.7384, 7.4246

Orientation: You are about to embark on a walking journey through La Marée restaurant, Monaco. As you arrive at this single stop, you will be immersed in the culinary excellence of La Marée, where Mediterranean seafood tradition is intricately woven with the innovative vision of its dedicated chef. Explore how the ocean's bounty meets human creativity, revealing a legacy of culinary dedication and innovation. La Marée Monaco, established in 2013 with a concept imported from Russia, has evolved under passionate leadership, including culinary influences from upscale Monaco restaurants like La Cremailler and La Régalade. Your first stop is La Marée. The restaurant's sleek, modern facade invites you in, promising an experience that merges culinary excellence with stunning views of the harbor.

La Marée quickly became a sought-after destination for both its exquisite seafood and its strategic location. Known for supplying top-tier seafood, the restaurant brings a passion for the ocean's offerings to Monaco, where each dish reflects this legacy. During the Monaco Grand Prix, one of the most prestigious events in the racing world, the restaurant gains heightened attention. La Marée becomes a sought-after viewing spot, with tables commanding prices in the tens of thousands of euros. La Marée offers a seafood-centric menu that draws from the freshest catches, honoring the Mediterranean's bounty. The journey from a small fishing village to the heart of Monaco's elite dining unfolds with every taste.
